verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a hosted and self-hosted error-tracking service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The docs only say GlitchTip 'aims to be Sentry API compatible', release notes merely mention 'breaking changes', and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Release-note mentions of breaking changes are not a documented deprecation policy and earn no credit.
